description: Conditions at a Puerto Rico surf, dive or kite spot, as 787daily's /conditions/ page shows them: its call for each activity, wave height (ft), period (s), wind (kt) and water temperature (°F) from NOAA buoys or the marine forecast. Every time is UTC (Z). Use list_condition_spots for valid keys.

spot.description: Spot key or name, e.g. 'rincon' (see list_condition_spots)
